messages:
nina: quick heads-up — i'm opening a PR to add a short migration + example section to model cards: quant variant support, seq-ceiling callouts, and an example SDK snippet. draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1501 :wave:

omar: Nice. Make sure we show the minimal SDK snippet and exact pip/cli install lines so customers can reproduce.

raj: Also include a tiny note about when to prefer variant naming vs using the model routing rules. Lots of confusion there.

lina: Can you add an illustrative 2-row table in the template (variant, tested_device, p50_ms, tokens_per_s, seq_limit)? Keep it small and link to the catalog table for full data.

nina: Will do. Plan: add "supported_quant" field to card template and the example table + SDK snippet. I'll update stale perf-harness links too.

omar: For SDK snippet, keep this example exact so copy/paste works: 
```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['RW_KEY'])
resp = client.generate(model='tempest13b', variant='tempest13b-int8', prompt='Explain X')
print(resp.text)
```

raj: Add a short sentence: "Verify seq_limit in model-catalog before assuming FP16 context lengths carry over to quant variants."

lina: Also add a reviewer checklist: eng-ml for numbers, eng-runtime for variant naming, docs for copyedit. docs-bot can add checklist on PR open?

docs-bot: I will post the PR checklist when the PR is opened. (automated)

nina: Good — i'll tag eng-ml and eng-runtime. One more: call out that quantized variants may change memory usage and recommend testing on a representative machine.

omar: If you update any canonical numbers, add a changelog entry and create a perf follow-up issue.

nina: Agreed. Drafting now; ETA today for reviewers to chime in. last_message_ts=3467890450
